profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer for StarCraft II

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer - StarCraft II
positions.description:
	Led a team of 3 engineers in the planning, development, deployment, and live support of StarCraft II client/server for PC/Mac, for over 1 million monthly active users.
	Oversaw the transition of StarCraft II from a box-sales based to a Free to Play business model, which increased sustained engagement and monthly active users by over 50%.
	Provided online and direct in-person engineering and operational support for tournaments such as GSL and ESL, as well as large-scale live esports competitions such as the WCS StarCraft II World Championship at BlizzCon.
	Primary engineer and point of contact on DeepMind AlphaStar, a research collaboration between Google DeepMind and Blizzard.  Partnered with up to 30 offsite engineers and data scientists to support DeepMind’s machine learning research.
	Developed and maintained sc2api, an open source interface and machine learning environment for C++ and python.  This environment enabled DeepMind to develop a machine learning agent capable of playing StarCraft II at a Grandmaster level versus humans.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Warcraft III: Reforged
positions.description:
	Worked with a team of onsite and offsite developers in multiple locations and disciplines to organize development efforts in the Warcraft III: Reforged client and server.
	Replaced a legacy hand-written C++ UI with an in-client HTLM5 Node.js JavaScript browser-based UI, to support a complete revamp of the Warcraft III: Reforged User Experience.

positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Planetside 2
positions.description:
	Worked with a team to develop the client, database, server, and UI for Planetside 2, an online Massively Multiplayer FPS for PC/PS4.
	Implemented features such as the HUD, mini map, in game progression system, player inventory and paper doll, item and vehicle customization UI, and in-game shop using Scaleform ActionScript, SQL lite, and C++.
	Ported the UI and gameplay controls from a keyboard and mouse PC based shooter to a PS4/PC controller scheme, including a context-sensitive radial and quick-action menu.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - International Operations
positions.description:
Developed and maintained the in-house content localization toolchain using C++, wxWidgets, Apache, Java, and Perl.
	Gameplay integration engineering for DC Universe Online, EverQuest 2, Vanguard: Saga of Heroes, as well as several console titles such as Untold Legends.
	Updated the Planetside client and server to add support for Russian and Chinese localization.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
	Worked with a team to develop the Websense Enterprise Server, a distributed high-performance real-time web classification and protocol filtering system.
	Identified and removed algorithmic bottlenecks in the nightly database build process. Reworked URL lookup engine to improve performance and scalability.
	Wrote a browser helper object plugin to optimize the workflow of a team of web analysts, enabling the efficient categorization of over 5 million URLs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
	Wrote a Linux device driver to interface with an in-house proprietary data acquisition and modulation/demodulation DSP array for a high-speed satellite Internet communication system in C and C++.  
	Developed a test harness and simulation suite of the networking layer, error correction, and rate-limiting protocols for a TCP/IP to XTP satellite layer 2 protocol bridge.
	Received patent for “System and method for clock correlated data flow in a multi-processor communication system.” (pat. no. 6,463,070)
